A Blog post by Ai2 on Hugging Face
A Blog post by Ai2 on Hugging Face
🤖 Models | 📄 Tech Report | 📊 Data | 💻 Code | 🌐 Project Page | 📈 Benchmark
Deploying robots in real-world settings requires reliable perception throughout an interaction. To pick something up, a robot needs to follow the positions of its gripper and the object as they move. In a laboratory, a robot handling a pipette must keep track of its tip while aligning it with the opening of a tube. These tasks become harder when nearby o
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Ai2发布RoboTrack基准与数据套件，含307个来自DROID等的人工标注视频，显示领先tracker在真实操作场景得分远低于既有基准，并推出在5项评测中4项达SOTA的RoboTracker-Warp。

en.reason: Ai2's RoboTrack benchmark and data suite includes 307 human-annotated videos from DROID and shows leading point trackers score far below existing benchmarks on real robotic manipulation, while its RoboTracker-Warp reaches state-of-the-art on four of five evaluations.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub 在公开预览中让 issue 不再只分 open/closed，而可用更细状态并在 repository boards 按 status: 筛选进度，还支持 GraphQL、REST API 和 MCP server 读写状态及 Copilot 自动化触发状态变更。

en.reason: GitHub issues now get finer statuses beyond open/closed in public preview, repository boards with status: filtering, and GraphQL, REST API and MCP server read/write access, with Copilot automation triggering status changes.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub Code Quality 的 upload-code-coverage action 现在校验报告须为 Cobertura XML，格式不符会让上传失败并在 Actions 日志报错，此前却看似成功但 PR 无覆盖率。

en.reason: GitHub Code Quality’s upload-code-coverage action now rejects non-Cobertura XML reports, failing the upload with “This file is not a Cobertura XML report” in the Actions log instead of appearing successful while leaving pull requests without coverage.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Mira Murati 的 Thinking Machines Lab 开源模型仅 26.4B 的 Inkling2Mini，循环 Transformer 让中间 12 层对每个 token 跑三次，做到想三遍再说话，笔记本可跑，ARC-AGI-2 上以每任务 0.14 美元拿到 49.3%。

en.title: Mira Murati’s team open-sources a model that thinks three times before speaking: the 26.4B recurrent Transformer tops Hugging Face and runs on a laptop

en.title: Mira Murati’s team open-sources a model that thinks three times before speaking: the 26.4B recurrent Transformer tops Hugging Face and runs on a laptop

en.title: Drawing a "perplexity" red line for AI development: OpenAI chief scientist proposes an industry threshold
en.reason: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki proposed an industry-wide standard and hard AI-development threshold barring companies that miss safety requirements, Bloomberg reported November 23; Microsoft AI CEO Suleyman shared it November 22 and pledged joint disclosure of pretraining progress.

sources.title: OpenAI 升级 ChatGPT，更可靠地处理复杂的日常问题、网页搜索和图像 / OpenAI updates ChatGPT to handle complex everyday questions, web searches, and images more reliably
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 升级 ChatGPT，更可靠地处理复杂的日常问题、网页搜索和图像
sources.title_en: OpenAI updates ChatGPT to handle complex everyday questions, web searches, and images more reliably
sources.title_original: OpenAI updates ChatGPT to handle complex everyday questions, web searches, and images more reliably
sources.summary:
OpenAI is making GPT-6.2 Sol the new default model in ChatGPT's chat tab, rolling it out worldwide. In internal tests, image understanding jumped from 47.4 to 71.7 percent, and the model now handles difficult instructions correctly 78.1 percent of the time. It also sticks to safety policies more consistently.

sources.title_original: Z.ai follows OpenAI into loop transformer territory with its new 750B flagship model
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Z.ai 将 750B 参数的 GLM-5.4 改为 28 层跑两次的 loop 架构，号称匹敌 2 至 3 万亿参数模型，但基准仅来自 30B 测试模型，并定位 Generalized Coding。

en.reason: Z.ai's GLM-5.4 uses a loop architecture where 28 layers run twice, which the company claims lets the 750-billion-parameter model match 2 to 3 trillion-parameter models, though benchmarks so far come only from a 30B test model.

stories.title: Anthropic 对算力的胃口，正推动 xAI 转向“以租代建”的策略 / Anthropic's appetite for compute is pushing xAI toward a rent-over-build strategy

sources.title: Anthropic 对算力的胃口，正推动 xAI 转向“以租代建”的策略 / Anthropic's appetite for compute is pushing xAI toward a rent-over-build strategy
sources.title_zh: Anthropic 对算力的胃口，正推动 xAI 转向“以租代建”的策略
sources.title_en: Anthropic's appetite for compute is pushing xAI toward a rent-over-build strategy
sources.title_original: Anthropic's appetite for compute is pushing xAI toward a rent-over-build strategy
sources.summary:
Since May, SpaceXSI has been renting compute to competitors like Anthropic and Google while scaling back its own AI projects. Anthropic pays about $3.1 billion a month, Google $800 million, the New York Times reports. After its June IPO, SpaceXSI disbanded the 60-person Grok Imagine team, among other cuts.

en.reason: Anthropic pays xAI roughly $3.1 billion a month and Google $800 million for compute, rentals that now exceed half its total revenue after the June IPO and the disbanding of its 60-person Grok Imagine team.

stories.title: OpenAI warns that upcoming AI systems could outpace safety checks and urges rivals to agree on shared limits

sources.title: OpenAI warns that upcoming AI systems could outpace safety checks and urges rivals to agree on shared limits
sources.title_en: OpenAI warns that upcoming AI systems could outpace safety checks and urges rivals to agree on shared limits
sources.title_original: OpenAI warns that upcoming AI systems could outpace safety checks and urges rivals to agree on shared limits
sources.summary:
OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki has released internal perplexity scores for the entire GPT series for the first time, up to an unreleased model beyond the current generation. The metric shows that core capabilities emerge at surprisingly precise thresholds. Pachocki is pushing to make perplexity an industry-wide progress metric and establish shared limits before control over AI behavior erodes.
OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki has released internal perplexity scores for the entire GPT

en.reason: Jakub Pachocki has published internal perplexity scores for the entire GPT series for the first time, noting GPT-4 at about 0.91 unlocked chain-of-thought and urging shared industry safety limits.

en.title: Learning Agent now is like getting into Douyin in 2018. If you had started learning self-media in 2020, you would surely have built up solid results by now; the same goes for starting to learn AI Agent development now. Back then, no one realized that self-media meant a disruption to content distribution: gaining hundreds or thousands of followers was no longer a privilege reserved for celebrities, and promoting a product no longer necessarily meant working with traditional media.

en.title: A2UI 1.0 explained: letting AI generate Flutter UIs without worrying it’ll write nonsense
en.reason: A2UI 1.0, released November 17, turns AI agent replies into interactive Flutter interfaces rather than text, renames genui to a2ui_flutter across three packages, and the article walks through five new capabilities, including a unit test of the two-layer "hierarchy guardrail" and Express using 46% fewer characters than compressed JSON.

en.title: The mainstream approach to AI knowledge bases is RAG — so how do you build RAG?
en.reason: RAG knowledge bases chunk documents into 300–800 characters with 10%–20% overlap, index them by vector and keyword for retrieval, then have the model answer with sources cited, starting with 50–200 core documents on an existing platform.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者用 Gemini in Google Antigravity 约30分钟为家庭库存应用 Home Vault 生成可安装 APK，并在 Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra 上测试其 Kotlin 与保修提醒等功能。

en.reason: Using Gemini in Google Antigravity, the author generated an installable APK for a family inventory app called Home Vault in about 30 minutes and tested its Kotlin build and warranty reminders on a Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra.
